title: Batch 47 leftovers: File metadata rights gap
description: Regression from df5a2d7b (filenode -19): MemoryBackend maySetMetadata check (crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/memory.rs ~1718) reads the node's own stored myRights; Files no longer carry myRights, so metadata writes to Files now always pass. -19 §5: a File's rights are its parent Directory's. Fix: use parent rights for non-Directory nodes; test with oracle -19 §5 text. Also: (a) FileNode/copy with an @type override now silently drops source-carried type-specific props (merge_filenode_overrides ~2213, e.g. role dropped when Directory copied as File; used to be invalidProperties) - matches -19 §3.1 but needs a CHANGELOG line and a test of the drop branch; (b) chat-filenode check_space_update root branches (~721) that allow restating the root name / parentId null have no positive test; (c) jmap-filenode-types README (lines 3,71,137,140) and src/backend.rs:16-46 still cite -16 §3.1.
